title: Telemetry SLO Consolidator and Cross-Team Dependency Visibility
creator: Lina Morales
description:
Problem: Teams lack a single consolidated view that maps SLIs and error-budget burn events to service dependencies and recent deploys. That makes it slow to diagnose cross-service incidents that drive SLO violations and forces manual coordination for mitigation.

Goal: Build a lightweight 'SLO consolidator' service and console surface that normalizes SLI telemetry across teams, annotates error-budget burn with recent deploys and infra incidents, and surfaces probable upstream dependencies for faster incident triage and automated suggested mitigations.

Scope:
- Ingest normalized SLI/metric streams (Prometheus, Datadog, internal SLI pipeline) and map them to canonical service identifiers.
- Correlate error-budget burn spikes with deployment metadata (git sha, rollout IDs), infra incidents (region outages, node pool autoscaler events), and recent config changes (routing, batching, quantization toggles).
- Provide a console panel and API endpoint that shows for a given initiative/SLO: current SLI, burn rate, top correlated dependencies, associated PRs/rollouts in the last 24h, and suggested next actions (rollback candidate, scale up pool, change routing).
- Emit standardized annotations to existing incident timelines and expose a webhook for runbook integrations.

Out of scope for this ticket: full automated rollback or cross-account private deployments. This MVP focuses on visibility and suggested mitigations only.
acceptance_criteria: A1: SLO consolidator ingests three telemetry sources (Prometheus, Datadog, internal SLI bus) and produces a unified SLI stream for at least two production SLOs.
A2: Console panel shows per-SLO burn rate, 24h correlated dependency list (top 5), and list of associated rollouts/PRs with timestamps.
A3: Correlation logic correctly attributes at least 70% of high-burn incidents in a 14-day test window to a candidate dependency or recent rollout (validated by on-call feedback).
A4: Webhook/annotation created for incidents that include consolidator findings and a reproducible example in the runbook.
A5: Documentation page and an example GitHub PR linking a rollout to an SLO annotation exist (confluence + GH links).
notes: 2026-03-03 Lina Morales: Kickoff meeting with SRE, Infra, and Console teams. Agreed on canonical service naming scheme and need for lightweight mapping table maintained in config repo.

2026-03-04 Omar Patel: Prototype ingestion pipeline using internal SLI bus + a Prometheus adapter. Early correlation uses Pearson coefficient over 15m windows; agreed this is MVP but may be replaced with causal heuristics later.
2026-03-05 SRE feedback: correlation must account for autoscaler churn (false positives). Action: tag autoscaler events and exclude short-lived spikes under 30s.
2026-03-06 Design review: Console panel should prioritize actions and provide linkouts to rollout PRs and the deployment timeline. Omar to provide mockups for devs by 2026-03-08.

2026-03-08 Engineering note (ENG-22111): Implemented a job that enriches SLI samples with rollout metadata from our rollout service. Found gaps in rollout tagging for model-variant rollouts; flagged as follow-up.
2026-03-09 Decision: Use a two-tier correlation score (statistical + metadata overlap). If both are present, surface as 'high confidence'. Otherwise show 'suspected'.
2026-03-10 Omar Patel: MVP ingestion and console backend merged to feature branch. Integration tests added. Next: run 14-day backfill and invite two on-call SEs for validation sessions.
implementation_notes: MVP correlation: 15m sliding windows, Pearson correlation + event overlap scoring.
Enrichment sources: rollout-service API, infra-incident webhook, deployment metadata table.
Normalization: adopt canonical service name mapping stored in infra-config repo (managed by platform).
Privacy: only surface PR IDs and rollout IDs; do not surface commit diffs in console by default.
follow_up_tasks: PM-141211: Add model-variant rollout tagging to rollout-service (blocked on ENG-23045).
ENG-22112: Improve correlation heuristics to reduce false positives from autoscaler churn.
PM-141220: Run cross-team validation sessions and collect on-call feedback for threshold tuning.
